title: Roses Ableton remake: bars 21–24 only

sound_and_midi_clips.comment: Original Ableton project uses same guitar sample on Guitar L and Guitar R tracks. Recreate original panning/processing only if available.
Use actual MIDI note events; original plugin Sylenth1 is not directly importable in browser.
MIDI clip controls sampled vocal chops starting bar 23. Interpret actual clip notes; do not loop sample at arbitrary timing.
Clip extends beyond bar 24; implement only requested portion and manage future extension carefully.
No clips overlapping source beats 80–96 on tracks named Kick, Snare 1, or related regular drum tracks. Keep Z/X manual; do not invent required drum hits.

existing_app_layers: Keep existing cued Roses vocals running and manually triggered Z kick / X clap, but stop prior 4-bar intro pad and break bass/sub at bar 21 when the new build takes over.
